## Orientation

Work in ~/se-workflow on feat/watch-dashboard (head 79fda7a). Use only isolated tmux servers (tmux -L <unique>), never the user's default server; kill them in teardown. The popup needs an attached client: attach one inside a Python pty and read the client's pty output, which shows the popup contents. Investigate the pane_current_path=/tmp quirk seen on a detached server. Do not edit ~/.tmux.conf, ~/.claude, or any .artifacts directory.
record.subject: verify-tmux-integration-phase
